welcome.title: A Place to Rest in the Cool Air of Darajat
welcome.description: Green Hero Darajat offers a comfortable stay for families with a mountain atmosphere and facilities that support a relaxing holiday. Located right in the Garut highlands, fresh air and natural panoramas become the best companions for your rest.
welcome.badgeDetail: Safe & comfortable facilities for all ages
welcome.mediaAlt: Green Hero Darajat resort and warm pool at dusk

warmWater.title: Natural Mountain Warm Water
warmWater.detail: Natural sulfur springs with a balanced temperature to relieve body fatigue.

coolAir.title: Cool & Pollution-Free Air
coolAir.detail: An average temperature of 16°C–20°C, refreshing amid Garut's green plantations.

valleyView.title: Garut Valley Views
valleyView.detail: Open panoramas of hills and a sea of morning mist straight from the resort grounds.

rooms.title: Room Choices for Your Journey
rooms.description: Designed to be luxurious, warm, and intimate for family togetherness in the embrace of the cool Darajat Pass mountains.

roastGoat.title: Roast Goat
roastGoat.detail: A shared dining option for large families, gatherings, or special moments during your stay at Green Hero.

bbq.title: BBQ & Grill
bbq.detail: Enjoy relaxing time with family with a grill package in the cool air of Darajat.

birthday.title: Birthday Celebration
birthday.detail: Make a birthday more memorable with decorations and celebration package options during your stay.

spring.mediaAlt: Guests soaking in the Green Hero Darajat warm pool with mountain views
spring.title: Warmth Amid the Mountain Air
spring.description: Enjoy relaxing time with family in the warm pool after taking in the cool Darajat area. Natural warm water at an ideal temperature for relaxing the body amid the cool highland air.

amenities.title: Everything You Need for a Comfortable Stay
amenities.description: Complete facilities to support a relaxing and enjoyable holiday with your beloved family.

pratama.quote: The atmosphere is very cool and the warm pool is the best for the kids after a day out in Darajat.
pratama.name: The Pratama Family

hendraMaya.quote: Clean rooms, lovely hill views, and the staff are very friendly. The best choice for a relaxing family holiday.
hendraMaya.name: Hendra & Maya

rina.quote: The place is calm, the air is clean, and the warm water facility makes you want to stay longer. We'll definitely come back!
rina.name: Rina S.

location.mapAlt: Illustration of the route to the Darajat Pass area in Garut
location.title: Explore Darajat
location.description: Located at the heights of Darajat Pass with smooth paved road access. Surrounded by vegetable plantations and views of geothermal craters, the perfect place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city.

finalCta.title: Ready for Your Stay in Darajat?
finalCta.description: Find the right room and plan your stay with family amid the comfort of the warm pool and the cool mountains.
